Programming
Part 3: Structuring Algorithms
with Pseudocode
By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
•
Explain how flowcharts represent algorithms
visually.
•
Identify the common symbols used in
programming flowcharts.
•
Represent sequence, selection, and iteration
using flowcharts.

Pseudocode
Pseudocode: An informal way of describing an algorithm using plain language
that resembles programming code but is not written in a specific
programming language.
PSEUDOCODE IS NOT CODE
• Pseudocode should be written as plain language to allow you to simplify
your thinking.
• Pseudocode should be able to be translated to any programming
language.
• If your pseudocode looks the same as your Python code, then you are
doing something wrong.
